block.description: Execute ruby code: Transform zone overrides to SFDC account zone products.

input.code:
require 'json'

# ============================================================
# Fun-1.2 | Account Zone Product Sync — Transform
# ============================================================
# CP zone overrides (zn:<zone>) → Account_Zone_Product__c candidates
# - pricing may be: overrides list, full pricing object, or JSON string
# - Only "zn:" overrides; dataset zones (zn:v__ds_*) ignored
# - Only price keys: req | gb | req_premium | gb_premium
# - account_zones = Web Unlocker zones only (filtered in SOQL)
# - SFDC Zone__c = "<customer_id>_<zone>" (e.g. hl_a7ffde91_mcp_unlocker)
# - not_bill → Status "Inactive" (Compare: skip if new, inactivate if exists)
# - Match key: Account_Zone__c + Product__c
# ============================================================

customer_id = input["customer_id"].to_s

pricing = input["pricing"]
2.times do
  pricing = (JSON.parse(pricing) rescue nil) if pricing.is_a?(String) && !pricing.strip.empty?
end

overrides =
  if pricing.is_a?(Array)
    pricing
  elsif pricing.is_a?(Hash) && pricing["prices_overrides"].is_a?(Array)
    pricing["prices_overrides"]
  else
    []
  end

wu_products   = input["wu_products"].is_a?(Array)   ? input["wu_products"]   : []
account_zones = input["account_zones"].is_a?(Array) ? input["account_zones"] : []

puts "overrides: #{overrides.size} | wu_products: #{wu_products.size} | account_zones: #{account_zones.size}"

ALLOWED_PRICE_KEYS = %w[req gb req_premium gb_premium].freeze

product_by_key = {}
wu_products.each do |p|
  k = p["Price_Key__c"]
  product_by_key[k] = p if ALLOWED_PRICE_KEYS.include?(k)
end

zone_by_name = {}
account_zones.each do |z|
  name = z["Zone__c"].to_s
  zone_by_name[name] = z unless name.empty?
end

records = []
skipped = []

overrides.each do |ov|
  next unless ov.is_a?(Hash)
  key = ov["ovrd_key"].to_s
  next unless key.start_with?("zn:")

  zone_name = key.sub(/\Azn:/, "")
  next if zone_name.start_with?("v__ds_")

  prices = ov["prices"]
  next unless prices.is_a?(Hash)

  wu_prices = prices.select { |k, _| ALLOWED_PRICE_KEYS.include?(k) }
  next if wu_prices.empty?

  zone = zone_by_name["#{customer_id}_#{zone_name}"]
  unless zone
    skipped << "NOT A WEB UNLOCKER ZONE ON THIS ACCOUNT: #{zone_name}"
    next
  end

  wu_prices.each do |price_key, data|
    next unless data.is_a?(Hash)

    product = product_by_key[price_key]
    unless product
      skipped << "PRODUCT NOT FOUND: Web Unlocker / #{price_key}"
      next
    end

    billed = data["not_bill"] != true
    cost   = data["num_value"]

    if billed && cost.nil?
      skipped << "NO PRICE: #{zone_name}/#{price_key}"
      next
    end

    records << {
      "Match_Key"       => "#{zone["Id"]}__#{product["Id"]}",
      "Account_Zone_Id" => zone["Id"],
      "Zone_Name"       => zone_name,
      "Product_Id"      => product["Id"],
      "Product_Code"    => product["ProductCode"],
      "Price_Key"       => price_key,
      "Cost"            => billed ? cost : nil,
      "Status"          => billed ? "Active" : "Inactive"
    }
  end
end

{
  "customer_id"   => customer_id,
  "records"       => records,
  "records_count" => records.size,
  "active_count"  => records.count { |r| r["Status"] == "Active" },
  "skipped"       => skipped,
  "skipped_count" => skipped.size
}

input.code:
# ============================================================
# Fun-1.2 | Account Zone Product Sync — Compare
# Compare and filter changed account zone price overrides
# ============================================================
# Same structure as Fun-1.1 Step 3 (Account only — zones live under Accounts):
#   resolve account (input, fallback from SFDC rows)
#   → EARLY EXIT with "error" if no account
#   → normalize + DEDUPE keys (one row per External_Zone_Override_ID)
#   → index SFDC → classify New / Changed / Unchanged / Skipped / Orphan
#   → all_records (lowercase, flat) for the caller
#   parent_type is always "Account", parent_id = account_id
# Key: External_Zone_Override_ID__c = "<customer_id>_<zone>_<price_key>" (lowercase)
# Every key appears ONCE across upsert / orphan / unchanged / skipped / all_records.
# ============================================================

require 'json'

new_records = input["new_records"]
sfdc_data   = input["sfdc_records"]
account_id  = input["account_id"]
customer_id = input["customer_id"].to_s
inactivate_orphans = input["inactivate_orphans"].to_s.downcase != "false"

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
def as_list(v)
  v = (JSON.parse(v) rescue []) if v.is_a?(String) && !v.strip.empty?
  return v if v.is_a?(Array)
  return v["records"] if v.is_a?(Hash) && v["records"].is_a?(Array)
  return v["Account_Zone_Price_Overrides__c"] if v.is_a?(Hash) && v["Account_Zone_Price_Overrides__c"].is_a?(Array)
  []
end

def normalize_num(v)
  return nil if v.nil? || v.to_s.strip == ""
  (Float(v) rescue nil)&.round(2)   # Cost__c is Currency(16,2)
end

def resolve_account(account_id, sfdc_list)
  return account_id.to_s.strip unless account_id.to_s.strip.empty?
  rec = sfdc_list.find { |r| r["Account__c"].to_s != "" }
  rec ? rec["Account__c"] : nil
end

def sfdc_key(r)
  ext = r["External_Zone_Override_ID__c"].to_s.strip
  return ext.downcase unless ext.empty?
  zone = r["Zone__c"].to_s
  pk   = r["Price_Key__c"].to_s
  return nil if zone.empty? || pk.empty?
  "#{zone}_#{pk}".downcase
end

# Keep one row per key (last wins); drop rows without a key
def unique_by(list, field)
  list.each_with_object({}) do |r, h|
    k = r[field].to_s.strip.downcase
    h[k] = r unless k.empty?
  end.values
end

def to_flat(r, account_id, meta)
  ext = (r["External_Zone_Override_ID__c"] || r["External_Zone_Override_ID"] || "").to_s
  m   = meta[ext.downcase] || {}
  {
    "account_id"      => account_id,
    "external_zone_override_id" => ext,
    "zone_name"       => r["Zone_Name"] || m["Zone_Name"] || "",
    "price_key"       => r["Price_Key"] || m["Price_Key"] || "",
    "account_zone_id" => r["Account_Zone__c"] || r["Account_Zone_Id"] || "",
    "product_id"      => r["Product__c"] || r["Product_Id"] || "",
    "cost"            => r.key?("Cost__c") ? r["Cost__c"] : r["Cost"],
    "status"          => r["Status__c"] || r["Status"] || "",
    "record_status"   => r["Record_Status"] || "",
    "change_reason"   => r["Change_Reason"] || "",
    "sfdc_record_id"  => r["SFDC_Record_Id"] || "",
    "parent_type"     => "Account",
    "parent_id"       => account_id
  }
end

# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================
new_records = as_list(new_records)
sfdc_list   = as_list(sfdc_data)
account_id  = resolve_account(account_id, sfdc_list)

# Make sure every record has its key (rebuild if Transform didn't pass it)
new_records.each do |rec|
  k = rec["External_Zone_Override_ID"].to_s.strip
  k = "#{customer_id}_#{rec["Zone_Name"]}_#{rec["Price_Key"]}" if k.empty?
  rec["External_Zone_Override_ID"] = k.downcase
end

# One input row per key (CP may send the same zone twice — last wins)
new_records = unique_by(new_records, "External_Zone_Override_ID")

# ============================================================
# EARLY EXIT IF NO ACCOUNT
# ============================================================
result = if account_id.nil?
  {
    "error"             => "No Account ID found — cannot upsert to SFDC",
    "upsert_list"       => [],
    "upsert_count"      => 0,
    "orphan_list"       => [],
    "orphan_count"      => 0,
    "unchanged_count"   => 0,
    "skipped_list"      => [],
    "skipped_count"     => 0,
    "all_records"       => [],
    "all_records_count" => 0,
    "account_id"        => nil,
    "parent_type"       => nil,
    "parent_id"         => nil
  }
else
  # ---------- INDEX EXISTING SFDC RECORDS (one per key) ----------
  sfdc_index = {}
  sfdc_list.each do |r|
    k = sfdc_key(r)
    sfdc_index[k] = r if k
  end

  # ---------- COMPARE & CLASSIFY ----------
  upsert_list, unchanged_list, skipped_list, orphan_list = [], [], [], []
  seen = {}

  new_records.each do |rec|
    key     = rec["External_Zone_Override_ID"]
    current = sfdc_index[key]

    if current.nil?
      if rec["Status"] == "Inactive"
        skipped_list << rec.merge("Record_Status" => "Skipped",
                                  "Change_Reason" => "not_bill and not in SFDC — not created")
      else
        upsert_list << {
          "External_Zone_Override_ID__c" => key,
          "Account_Zone__c" => rec["Account_Zone_Id"],
          "Product__c"      => rec["Product_Id"],
          "Cost__c"         => rec["Cost"],
          "Status__c"       => "Active",
          "Record_Status"   => "New",
          "Change_Reason"   => "New zone override (#{rec["Zone_Name"]}/#{rec["Price_Key"]})"
        }
      end
      next
    end

    seen[key] = true
    cur_status = current["Status__c"].to_s.empty? ? "Active" : current["Status__c"]
    new_cost   = rec["Status"] == "Inactive" ? current["Cost__c"] : rec["Cost"]

    reasons = []
    reasons << "Cost: #{current["Cost__c"]} → #{new_cost}" if normalize_num(current["Cost__c"]) != normalize_num(new_cost)
    reasons << "Status: #{cur_status} → #{rec["Status"]}"  if cur_status != rec["Status"]
    reasons << "External ID backfilled"                    if current["External_Zone_Override_ID__c"].to_s.strip.empty?

    if reasons.empty?
      unchanged_list << rec.merge("Record_Status" => "Unchanged", "SFDC_Record_Id" => current["Id"])
    else
      upsert_list << {
        "External_Zone_Override_ID__c" => key,
        "Account_Zone__c" => rec["Account_Zone_Id"],
        "Product__c"      => rec["Product_Id"],
        "Cost__c"         => new_cost,
        "Status__c"       => rec["Status"],
        "Record_Status"   => "Changed",
        "SFDC_Record_Id"  => current["Id"],
        "Change_Reason"   => "#{rec["Zone_Name"]}/#{rec["Price_Key"]}: " + reasons.join(" | ")
      }
    end
  end

  # ---------- ORPHAN DETECTION ----------
  if inactivate_orphans
    sfdc_index.each do |key, r|
      next if seen[key]
      next if r["Status__c"] == "Inactive"
      orphan_list << {
        "External_Zone_Override_ID__c" => key,
        "SFDC_Record_Id"  => r["Id"],
        "Account_Zone__c" => r["Account_Zone__c"],
        "Product__c"      => r["Product__c"],
        "Cost__c"         => r["Cost__c"],
        "Status__c"       => "Inactive",
        "Record_Status"   => "Orphan",
        "Change_Reason"   => "Zone override removed in CP — mark inactive"
      }
    end
  end

  # ---------- GUARANTEE UNIQUE KEYS IN EVERY LIST ----------
  upsert_list    = unique_by(upsert_list,    "External_Zone_Override_ID__c")
  orphan_list    = unique_by(orphan_list,    "External_Zone_Override_ID__c")
  unchanged_list = unique_by(unchanged_list, "External_Zone_Override_ID")
  skipped_list   = unique_by(skipped_list,   "External_Zone_Override_ID")

  # A key lives in ONE list only (priority: upsert > orphan > unchanged > skipped)
  taken = {}
  [[upsert_list, "External_Zone_Override_ID__c"], [orphan_list, "External_Zone_Override_ID__c"],
   [unchanged_list, "External_Zone_Override_ID"], [skipped_list, "External_Zone_Override_ID"]].each do |list, f|
    list.reject! { |r| taken[r[f].to_s.downcase] }
    list.each    { |r| taken[r[f].to_s.downcase] = true }
  end

  # ---------- UNIFIED FLAT LIST (lowercase, unique) for caller ----------
  meta = {}
  new_records.each { |r| meta[r["External_Zone_Override_ID"]] = r }
  all_records = unique_by(
    (upsert_list + orphan_list + unchanged_list + skipped_list).map { |r| to_flat(r, account_id, meta) },
    "external_zone_override_id"
  )

  # ---------- BUILD RESULT ----------
  {
    "upsert_list"       => upsert_list,
    "upsert_count"      => upsert_list.size,
    "orphan_list"       => orphan_list,
    "orphan_count"      => orphan_list.size,
    "unchanged_count"   => unchanged_list.size,
    "skipped_list"      => skipped_list,
    "skipped_count"     => skipped_list.size,
    "all_records"       => all_records,
    "all_records_count" => all_records.size,
    "account_id"        => account_id,
    "parent_type"       => "Account",
    "parent_id"         => account_id,
    "error"             => nil
  }
end
